title: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps to the white sand beaches and world class Rosemary Beach restaurants- Perfect location – 3 minute walk to the private beach, 3 minute walk to restaurants (relax at home as you await the text that your table is ready!)- Sun filled family room/kitchen – vaulted beamed ceiling, comfy couch and chairs, 50” TV, dining table, modern décor, washer/dryer room- Private balcony - perfect for that morning coffee, happy-hour cocktail, and a good book- Large, serene bedroom – full bathroom, king-size bed, nightstands, 50” TV- Access to a community pool right across the street with both sun and shade reclining- Private garage parking- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Memories on Water Carriage House is an adorable mini version of Memories on Water Main House. Guests will love the lush landscaping at the entrance, the dramatic exposed ceiling beams in the living area, and the tasteful interior coastal accents. Guests have everything they need in the full kitchen and will enjoy welcoming the day from a private balcony. A guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo.Guests can explore all that Rosemary Beach offers on 2 included adult bikes. With a location, this close to the beach, Memories on Water will book quickly. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:CARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboAdditional Living: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home.
